templates.name: PostgreSQL
templates.compose:
services:

    image: postgres:16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_NAME}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:5432"
    volumes:
      - data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  data:
notes: Reachable on the host port you set. Leave it internal by removing the port mapping if only other containers need it.

templates.name: Ghost
templates.tagline: Publishing platform for blogs and newsletters
templates.compose:
services:
  db:
    image: mysql:8
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: ghost
      MYSQL_USER: ghost
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${DB_ROOT_PASSWORD}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping", "-h", "localhost", "-p${DB_ROOT_PASSWORD}"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 20
    volumes:
      - db:/var/lib/mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
  ghost:
    image: ghost:5
    environment:
      url: http://localhost:${PORT}
      database__client: mysql
      database__connection__host: db
      database__connection__user: ghost
      database__connection__password: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      database__connection__database: ghost
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "${PORT}:2368"
    volumes:
      - content:/var/lib/ghost/content
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  db:
  content:
notes: Set your real URL after first run so links and images resolve correctly.

    healthcheck:

notes: The first visit sets up the admin account.
